# Styles

A style is a bundle of choices on six layers. A pack is a head start for a style that
has been built before: what it is and when it suits, how it is built, its quality bar
and typical failure, and starting values. The brief and the user's profile override
any pack. Read only the packs this video uses.

| Pack | Fits when | Evidence |
| --- | --- | --- |
| [Talking head](talking-head/README.md) | A person explains or tells a story to camera | Built in about ten projects |
| [Skit and meme](skit/README.md) | Silent acting; one on-screen line carries the joke and a sound carries the energy | Three references measured, two built |
| [Screen demo](screen-demo/README.md) | The product or result is on a screen | A sketch from demo inserts in talking-head edits |
| [Reel recreation](recreation/README.md) | Matching a posted reel's timing, text and camera | Two built |

Styles without a pack (voiceover explainer, commentary over a source, montage) are
built from the same layers; voiceover and commentary borrow the talking-head pack's
visuals and captions.

## Layers

| Layer | The question it answers | Examples |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Spine | What clock runs the edit? | Speech cut by phrase, a sound's beats, on-screen action, narration |
| Structure | How do the beats pay off? | Story, setup → payoff, list, contrast, before/after, demo steps |
| Picture | What is on screen and how does the camera behave? | Face to camera, held skit shot, meme clip, screen capture, sourced evidence; locked off, handheld drift, push-in |
| Text | What words are on screen? | Subtitles, one boxed skit caption from frame one, a list header, a hook headline |
| Sound | What carries the energy? | Dialogue, a trending or reference sound, a music bed, the meme's own audio |
| Effects | What lands on a picture beat? | Dip to black, explosion wipe, punch-in, shake, speed change |

## Mixing styles

- One spine per section. The spine can hand over at a marked boundary (a silent skit
  hook hands off to speech at 0:03), but two clocks never run at once.
- A layer borrowed from another style earns its place by fixing a real weakness of
  this video (a slow hook, a flat shot, no payoff, an uncovered claim), and follows
  its home pack inside its own interval: a meme cut-in in a talking head uses the
  skit pack's crop and sound for its 1–2 s.
- Change text treatment, loudness, color and camera deliberately at each seam. When a
  hook caption and subtitles share a video, give them different positions and
  treatments.

## Add a pack

When a project builds or measures a style with no pack, add a row here with the
project as evidence; give it a folder when it needs more than a row. A pack holds craft
any editor of that style would want. One creator's taste goes to their profile.
